headerDisplay: Connects Voltie EV chargers on your local network via the charger's HTTP API (default port 5059). Enable the HTTP API on the charger first.

discovery.title: Automatic discovery (mDNS/Bonjour)
discovery.description: Find Voltie chargers on the local network automatically. Chargers listed below are used as-is; discovery adds any others it finds.

username.title: Username (all chargers)
username.description: Used for every charger, including discovered ones, unless a charger entry has its own credentials. Only needed when the HTTP API has authentication enabled.

currentControl.title: Charging current dimmer (Lightbulb) (all chargers)
currentControl.description: Exposes the charging current limit as a dimmer: 0% = 6 A, 100% = hardware maximum. Siri can set it as a percentage.

chargeCompleteSensor.title: Charge complete sensor (Contact Sensor) (all chargers)
chargeCompleteSensor.description: Opens when the car finishes charging on its own (typically full) while still plugged in. A deliberate stop does not trigger it. Ideal for a "car is charged" notification.

accessLock.title: RFID access lock (Lock) (all chargers)
accessLock.description: Locked = charging requires an RFID card, Unlocked = free charging.

singlePhaseSwitch.title: Single-phase charging switch (all chargers)

oneOf.title: Auto (only when the charger supports it)

singlePhaseSwitch.description: Forces 1-phase charging (useful for solar surplus). Auto shows the switch only on chargers that report phase-switching support.

rebootSwitch.title: Reboot switch (all chargers)
rebootSwitch.description: Momentary switch that reboots the charger. Keep disabled unless you need it.

rearLedLight.title: Rear LED light (color Lightbulb) (all chargers)
rearLedLight.description: Exposes the charger's rear LED strip as a color lamp. The effect expires after an hour (firmware limit).

username.title: Username
username.description: Only needed if the charger's HTTP API has authentication enabled.

idTag.title: RFID id_tag for remote start
idTag.description: Optional. Sent with the start command when the charger requires RFID authorization.
